size.value: "Deux (02) photos d'identité aux formats de l'Organisation internationale de l'Aviation civile (OACI), c'est-à-dire 45mm x 35mm" (two ICAO-format identity photos, 45×35mm — matches DB's 3.5×4.5cm exactly)

validity.value: "une photo d'identité en couleur datant de moins de six (06) mois" (a color identity photo less than six (6) months old)

file_spec.value: "format PNG ou JPEG (Aucune photo scannée ne sera acceptée)" — PNG or JPEG format only; scanned photos are explicitly rejected

official_source_url.value: https://dei.gouv.bj/services/passeports (Direction de l'Émigration et de l'Immigration — DEI)

size.evidence: Two independent official sources agree: the DEI's own downloadable PIECES A FOURNIR PDF (dei.gouv.bj) states 'formats de l'OACI, c'est-à-dire 45mm x 35mm' for minors born in Benin/abroad, and the Benin Embassy in the US (beninembassy.us) independently states 'format passeport (35mm/45mm)' with white background for the general ordinary biometric passport. Both match DB's 3.5×4.5cm exactly.
